unit_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a production game sprite atlas, NOT a poster. Use the attached Pocket Kingdoms illustration ONLY as style reference: premium 3D tabletop miniature, chunky cute adult proportions with serious equipment, softly sculpted materials, clean readable silhouettes. True transparent background with NO background gradient, no shadows outside each cell, no text, no labels, no frames, no terrain bases. Exactly SIX separate isolated full-body game sprites in a strict 3-column by 2-row grid, 1536x1024 canvas, six equal 512x512 cells. Every sprite including weapon/horse fully inside its own cell with at least 45px padding; never crosses cell edges. Each sprite centered horizontally in its cell, feet/wheels aligned at y=455 inside cell. Orthographic isometric 3/4 view facing southeast (screen lower right), camera looking down 25 degrees. Consistent light from upper left. Human sprites about 360px tall including helmet/hat, cavalry about 390px tall, siege 390px wide. Crisp visible shapes, no motion blur or particles. ROLE ORDER is mandatory: top-left Villager holding mallet with work satchel; top-middle Warrior with spear AND shield; top-right female bow infantry with clearly visible bow; bottom-left armored mounted Horseman holding spear; bottom-middle lightly dressed mounted Scout, no armor and short spotting staff, visually distinct from Horseman; bottom-right wooden wheeled Siege engine with throwing arm, no human attached. Each exactly one complete sprite.

True transparent alpha background; NO background, NO gradients or scenery between sprites, NO text or labels, NO grids or frames, no people or units. Exactly TEN individual buildings in a strict 4-column x3-row grid on a 2048x1536 canvas. Consistent orthographic isometric view, camera elevated30degrees, two visible sides, front faces screen lower right. hero_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished game menu hero illustration for Pocket Kingdoms, a mobile isometric medieval real-time strategy game. Transparent background. Landscape 3:2 composition, all subjects fully inside with generous transparent margin, no text or logos. Art direction: modern premium 3D tabletop miniatures, approachable cute proportions with serious strategic character, soft sculpted forms, subtle painted material texture, precise silhouettes, attractive faces, believable equipment, NOT realistic humans, NOT baby toys or anime. A small confident field company: a stocky builder in straw hat carrying a wooden mallet, a helmeted shield-and-spear warrior, and a copper-haired female archer holding a simple bow. Roughly three-and-a-half-head-tall stylized adult figures. Behind and beneath them a compact isometric village vignette with one pale limestone town hall with teal roof, a modest timber house, one rounded tree and a tiny patch of wheat on a small natural moss-and-stone island plinth. Grounded medieval materials and purposeful expressions. Deep teal cloth and roofs, warm cream stone, honey gold accents and restrained terracotta details; warm studio key light and cool soft fill. Readable at small size, clean edges, balanced centered group, graceful negative space. Cohesive high-end indie strategy identity. No UI, no lettering, no ornate border, no background rectangle. Output PNG with genuine alpha.

Fix ONLY spacing and transparent canvas layout. Place every complete building, including ALL flag tips, chimney smoke and every corner of its foundation, well inside separate cells in an exactly regular 4-column by3-row grid. Within each cell use only the CENTRAL 75% of cell width and CENTRAL 75% of cell height: at least12.5% completely transparent padding on every side. No object, smoke, shadow, or vegetation may extend into these gutters or touch another object's rectangle. Scaling each whole sprite down to fit is required; do NOT crop pieces. Rows1 and2 have4 objects each, row3 has Blacksmith then Watch Tower then TWO COMPLETELY EMPTY TRANSPARENT CELLS. Keep original order and preserve all ten objects. Transparent background, no text, no grid lines, no background glow, no scenery between objects. Output4:3 aspect ratio. This is an asset-spacing repair, not a redesign.
